label: Python API

structure.rule: no business logic; validate with pydantic, delegate to services
the only package that imports the database driver
every dependency is declared here; the virtualenv is never committed

notes: Request and response models are pydantic classes at the API boundary; services never receive raw dicts.
No blocking IO inside async handlers; use the async driver or run blocking work in a thread.
`ruff check .`, `mypy .`, and `pytest` clean before a task is done.
Dependencies are pinned through the lock file the project chose (pip-tools, uv, or poetry); state which in tech.md.
